test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 09 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘FLOAT’ is written as ‘WONZI’ and ‘TRIBE’ is written as ‘DUHEW’. How will ‘GARDEN’ be written in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/130e026a7c3720f6f9db70163ea219cbcf01f13f419b49f6b5b6c1ad7f909510.png] 

**Logic: **

**1) Addition of + 3 in all the consonants.**

**2) Subtraction of - 1 in all the Vowels.**

**3) First and last letters are interchanged.**

1) 'FLOAT' is written as 'WONZI'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c50f151ef1e09f4d010add7740b0b8563ad6ae491f76792417790bcfb2865615.png] 

And,

2) 'TRIBE' is written as 'DUHEW'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b5e1da07ddfc7b89fde2e8ce80ea41a7dce80f795ab05f4e0e8d6ad0b450da3.png] 

Similarly,

3) 'GARDEN' is written as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d12dfb7b1c25b038bbfb6468e934945d1e1c9bda07bcd00355123212a427798.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"QZUGDJ".**
